The later local code commit `331947ab001025e3e296706c5343a492714a70b4`
has exactly that tree. Neither identifier is a measured edit-loop SHA: no real
calibration series has run.

(88d9e12ae 2026-08-18). Process-local Cargo jobs 1, default libtest threads,
target borrowed exclusively from `C:/src/quantick-worktrees/fix-mutation-retry-truth/target`.
The shared machine itself was not exclusive; unrelated builds were observed
and left untouched. These are verification runs, not performance measurements.

Original execution session 95914 / wrapper PID 24836 returned outer exit 1.
Retry session 15665 / wrapper PID 36080 returned outer exit 0. The original

expected NotAllowed. Its cause remains unproven; neither isolated success nor
the source-local environment mutex concern is presented as a proven fix.

The retry was explicitly authorized after bounded diagnosis, with unchanged
source/fixture inputs. Earlier fmt/clippy/build successes are retained from
their actual executions; this is not described as a fresh entire ordered loop.
Root journal: https://github.com/milocaetano/quantick/issues/472#issuecomment-5673472334.
The journal's lease label 02:12 is not the execution timestamp: actual start is
the scoped process timestamp above. Target release was sent after terminal
status and wrapper absence at 01:56:03.9777802Z; no cleanup occurred.

## Raw proof and exclusions

Original nonempty scoped chunks are `full-loop-1e76097a-scoped-start.log`,
`-1.log`, `-3.log`, `-14.log`, `-15.log`, and `-16.log`. Gaps in numbering are
empty polls. The complete failure is in `-15.log` (42242 tokens), not a tail
excerpt. Capture/source-line reconciliation and evidence-authoring diagnostics
are in `validation-capture-provenance.md`.

The original `full-loop-1e76097a.log` Start-Transcript file is private,
contaminated with ambient console content, excluded from publication, and not
used as verification evidence. Never copy or read it into the archive.

Diagnosis commands, raw outputs and limits are retained separately in
`profile-pointer-same-binary-diagnosis.log`, `profile-pointer-diagnosis.md`,
`profile-hook-reproduction.json`, `profile-hook-reproduction.md`,
`full-app-diagnosis-chunk-0.json`, `full-app-diagnosis-chunk-1.json`, and
`full-app-diagnosis.md`. The two pre-test shell invocation failures are preserved
in the hook reproduction report and `profile-hook-launch-failure.json`.

Retry full scoped outputs and metadata are `step4-retry-chunk-0.json` through
`step4-retry-chunk-3.json`, with no stored truncation. `step4-retry-release.json`
records unchanged input identity and terminal wrapper absence. Exact retry
command script is `retry-step4-1e76097a.ps1`; it uses no Start-Transcript.

Current-base offline proof is `offline-tests-30-1e76097a.log` (30 PASS),
`ms1-adopted-offline-supplement.log` (read-cost 9, frozen lexer 17, ruff PASS),
and `ms1-adopted-frozen-guards.log` (all seven initial frozen Git blobs match
HEAD/index; guards/hygiene PASS). These earlier unchanged-input checks were
not repeated merely because a session resumed.

fixed budgets, passing edit-loop budget job, final-head CI, independent final

measurement must keep its intentional uncalibrated-budget failure and all raw
samples; a reviewed fixed budget and separate checked run are still required.
Actual cron execution remains parent/main pending after the trader's merge.

The local code commit completed under the standing commit instruction
immediately before root's later hold message was delivered; it was reported
at once. Further commits/base adoption are held for the imminent A1R campaign
tip. A changed base requires actual new applicable verification, not relabeling
these retained old-base receipts.
